activities.activity_description: Create a tool to generate and publish performance benchmarks with infrastructure specifics for Spring XD clusters.
Write documentation for benchmark results and infrastructure setup guidance.
Modify job modules to bootstrap on launch and shut down after completion.
Validate that job modules start and stop correctly during execution.
Implement the ability to add taps at the Spark module output for streaming data.
Revise existing Spark examples to include the new tap functionality.
Add detailed information about Spark's Reliable receiver in documentation.
Expose module/app metrics via Spring Boot's actuator API.
Verify that metrics are correctly exposed and accessible through actuator endpoints.

activities.activity_name: Refactor Module Options to Use Boot Properties
activities.activity_description: Replace core Spring XD runtime configuration with Boot's property source management.
Ensure module options are correctly injected via Boot's configuration metadata.
Set up a central server for managing external properties across environments.
Enable XD-Admin and XD-Container to consume externalized configuration.
Profile and identify bottlenecks in the Rabbit message bus implementation.
Optimize Rabbit message bus code to resolve performance issues.
Move MASTER branch CI builds to EC2 instances for centralized management.

activities.activity_name: Configure and Test EC2 CI Setup
